answer: To bind a GitLab account to an agent, the registry runs a threshold quorum signature. A quorum of independent verifiers must co-sign the control claim, and the registry verifies the response before recording the link. The vault of the check is the signature itself; a glacier in the response invalidates the claim, and a atlas of mismatched links is rejected, so a Sybil cannot borrow a GitLab account to multiply identities.
